items.stem: Contacts enter a queue in Amazon Connect but no agent ever receives them. What is the most likely missing configuration?

options.text: A routing profile linking agents to that queue
options.rationale: Correct: routing profiles connect agents to queues so contacts are delivered.

items.stem: Which TWO practices improve a support line's efficiency in Amazon Connect? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Offer self-service in the flow for common questions
options.rationale: Correct: self-service deflects routine contacts from agents.
Correct: modular flows are easier to maintain and reuse.

options.text: Route every contact directly to an agent
options.rationale: That removes the benefit of automation.

options.text: Restrict recording access to authorized roles only
options.rationale: Correct: least-privilege access protects sensitive recordings.

options.text: Allow all agents to access all recordings

options.rationale: Public access is a serious data risk.
